title: Improving Well-being-related Resources for Special Education Teachers
what_it_is: Improving Well-being-related Resources for Special Education Teachers

sections.label: Journeys of Excellence Package funding
sections.summary: SPED schools will implement the Journeys of Excellence Package, developed by MOE with SPED schools, including funding for salaries and professional development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: In the immediate term, SPED schools will implement the Journeys of Excellence Package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: This package was developed by MOE in collaboration with SPED schools and includes funding support for competitive salaries and professional development support to enhance the professionalism of teachers.

sections.label: SPED relief teachers and recruitment
sections.summary: MOE will work with SPED schools and SSAs on a relief teacher pool, joint marketing and better human resource management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: MOE will work with our SPED Schools and SSAs to jointly develop a pool of relief teachers who can step in when needed, so that SPED teachers can go for training and be supported when they need to be away for other reasons such as medical or urgent leave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Third, to strengthen their manpower resourcing, MOE will explore working with SPED schools to do joint marketing as a sector to better recruit teachers and improve their human resource management and processes.

sections.label: Non-teaching staff in ecosystem
sections.summary: The first point is that non-teaching staff are being looked at as part of the entire ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The first point is that we are indeed looking at the non-teaching staff as part of the entire ecosystem.

sections.label: SPED profiles and collective agreement
sections.summary: Different SPED profiles require teachers with different backgrounds and training, and there is a collective agreement with SPED schools and SSAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: This is where a different SPED profile will require teachers with different background and training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We have collective agreement with all the SPED schools and the SSAs that we must come together.

sections.label: Parental leave workforce impact
sections.summary: MOE is aware that increased shared parental leave and other leave schemes will impact its workforce in MOE and MSF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: MOE, both for the mainstream schools and in the SPED schools, is keenly aware that the increase in shared parental leave and other leave schemes will have an impact on our workforce because many of the people at the child-bearing age are with us in MOE and the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF).

sections.label: Building specialised SPED teacher pool
sections.summary: A SPED teacher specialising in one profile mainly caters to that profile, and MOE is committed to building this pool with MSF, SSAs and SPED schools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: A SPED teacher that specialises in a special needs profile is more likely to only be able to cater to that profile of students and their needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, for us to build up that pool, it is not something that is easy, but it is something that MOE is committed to working on with MSF, the SSAs and our SPED schools, to build this up progressively.
